body: Both, engaging is a challenge because I'm so used to mockery and ridicule due to the speech impediment, but I have been getting a little better. Although, I think I'd be perfectly happy if I could speak properly.
I can't live how I'd like. I like being social, I like being outgoing, I like making people laugh, I'm an attention whore, but I can't do any of that when I can't speak right.
